title: 中文維基百科有聲條目
author: 維基百科社群 · 朗讀 Yuriy kosygin
description: The opening paragraph of the Chinese Wikipedia article on Haishan Fishing Port, a working harbour of fishing rafts and sampans on the Hsinchu coast of Taiwan, read aloud by the Taiwanese volunteer who wrote the article.
levelReason: A third of the passage is silence — 35 pauses in 84 seconds — so each clause lands before the next one starts. The speed is not what makes this Intermediate; the vocabulary is: harbour and inshore-fishing terms arrive one per sentence with no repetition, and the last two lines are a list of six fish
learningGoal: Follow a Taiwanese reference article read at teaching pace, and learn the frame Chinese uses to put a place on the map: 位於 for the address, 西臨 for what it faces, and a compass direction with a distance for everything nearby.

transcript.text: 位於新竹市香山區海山里西濱公路旁，
可供350艘以上的漁筏停泊、
港區配合產業道路佈置，
主要提供平時即季風期漁筏、
颱風時仍須拖曳上岸或駛往鄰近的新竹漁港避風。
為僅次於新竹漁港之新竹市沿海第二個專業漁港。
該港船隻多經營沿岸定置網、刺網、一支釣等漁業或於沿岸插蚵、淺海養殖，
漁獲物以烏魚、鯛、烏賊、白帶魚、鰆魚

vocabulary.meaning: Is located at. The standard opening move of a Chinese reference article about a place — it comes before the address, not after it.
vocabulary.example: 位於新竹市香山區海山里西濱公路旁，

vocabulary.meaning: Borders on the west. 臨 is to face or adjoin; put any compass direction in front of it to say which side something faces.
Anchorage — the sheltered water inside a harbour where boats moor. Measured in hectares, as here, rather than in berths.
A fishing raft: the small flat craft Taiwanese crews use close to shore. Smaller than a trawler, and counted in hundreds at a harbour this size.
vocabulary.example: 可供350艘以上的漁筏停泊、

vocabulary.meaning: To pull in and moor. Used of a boat at a harbour and, just as commonly, of a train calling at a station.

options: On the Hsinchu coast, facing the Taiwan Strait
On Taiwan's east coast, facing the Pacific
On an offshore island in the Taiwan Strait

questions.prompt: What kind of boats does it mainly serve?
options: Deep-sea trawlers that stay out for weeks
Small fishing rafts and sampans working close to shore

questions.prompt: What happens to the boats when a typhoon comes?
options: They shelter behind the breakwater inside the harbour
They are hauled ashore or moved to nearby Hsinchu Fishing Harbour
They put out to sea to ride out the storm
